name: mini-product-row
title: Mini product row
description: A one-line product reference for suggestions, bundles and pickers: thumbnail, name, option and price, as a link, a button or a plain row.
docs: Give it href for a link or onClick for a button; with neither it is a plain row. trailing stays a separate control above the stretched link, so a checkbox or a remove button is safe. selected adds a check and aria-pressed (button) or aria-current (link).
